implementation: Added a native Tiny CNN and torchvision ResNet18 factory. ResNet18 weights are pinned to the official IMAGENET1K_V1 URL; random initialization is offline, and pretrained weights require explicit allow_download opt-in when the verified cache is absent.

Added cache evidence with source URL, path, SHA-256 and expected hash-prefix verification. Missing cache returns PRETRAINED_WEIGHTS_NOT_CACHED without network access; cached classifier weights retain the feature extractor and reset the task-specific fc head.

Added real class-folder batch factory that composes content indexing, deterministic class split, ordered transform execution, decoded RGB samples, tensor/target shape checks, and dataset/split/sample fingerprints.

The batch callable advances deterministic epoch ordering and provides state_dict/load_state_dict hooks for checkpoint resume. The training callable returns cross-entropy loss and named accuracy through the existing managed-step protocol.
Added example project wrappers and a copy-and-run Tiny CNN budget-try guide; custom code remains replaceable through ordinary Python callables.

Coordinator completed the human onboarding route: the Tiny CNN adapter uses local class folders, explicit confirmation, no-overwrite writes, envelope binding for probe, and the shared managed-step training function.

limitations: Preset catalog API describe_presets() exposes Tiny CNN and ResNet18 without importing optional ML libraries, and direct embedded model factory invocation works; however, m-model currently has no human-facing presets list/search command, and onboarding currently offers Tiny CNN only. ResNet18 discoverability is through the example docs/direct factory path, not an interactive preset picker; this CLI integration is outside DATA-05 owned files.
